screen.toolmastery.sell_blocked_by: %s was bought on top of this node — sell that one first.
screen.toolmastery.enchant_needs_unlock: Unlock this node before you can enchant with it.

screen.toolmastery.unlock_needs_node: Unlock %s first — ranks are bought in order.

screen.toolmastery.confirm.tier_body: Spends %s XP points and opens every node of this tier for unlocking. The gate you completed stays completed.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.unlock_body_p: Spends the XP and the materials listed above, once. %1$s switches on the moment it is unlocked — there is no second step and nothing to apply to a tool.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.unlock_body_e: Spends the XP and the materials listed above, once. From now on %1$s can turn up in your enchanting table offers, and the Enchant button stamps it straight onto the item in your hand for %2$s XP, as many times as you like.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.unlock_body_c: Spends the XP and the materials listed above, once. %1$s never rolls at an enchanting table, so the Enchant button is the only way onto a tool — %2$s XP a time, as many times as you like.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.sell_body: Refunds %s XP — one fifth of the unlock price. Materials are not refunded, and the perk stops working the moment it is sold. You can buy it back later at full price.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.buy_body: Spends %s XP and drops a filled map in your inventory, an X marking the biome it found. Where it points is the gamble — buy as many as you can afford. Nothing is spent if no biome is found.
screen.toolmastery.confirm.enchant_body: Spends XP points and enchants the item in your main hand. Repeatable on any compatible item. It is priced above the enchanting table on purpose: the table is the cheaper route, this is the guaranteed one.
screen.toolmastery.help: Click a node to see what it does. A green frame is already yours, a pulsing gold one is ready to unlock, grey is still out of reach and red was locked out by a capstone choice. Lines join a rank to the rank that unlocks it. Unlock buys a node once with XP points plus materials; passives start working straight away and enchantments join your enchanting table. Enchant then stamps an unlocked enchantment on the item in your hand, as often as you like. An owned node can be sold back for a fifth of its XP. Click a tier header for its gate achievements, and use Track to pin a goal's missing gates to your HUD.

node.toolmastery.masons_grip_1.desc: Passive: mine stone, deepslate and ores 20% faster with a pickaxe.
node.toolmastery.masons_grip_2.desc: Passive: raises the stone, deepslate and ore bonus to 40%.
node.toolmastery.masons_grip_3.desc: Passive: raises the stone, deepslate and ore bonus to 60%.
node.toolmastery.miners_magnet.desc: Passive: drops from blocks broken with a pickaxe go straight into your inventory instead of landing on the ground — the extras from Dig Range and Rich Vein included, and whatever Smelt already smelted. Anything that does not fit is left where it fell.
node.toolmastery.smelt_1.desc: Enchantment: each raw ore you mine has a 25% chance to come out already smelted.
node.toolmastery.smelt_2.desc: Enchantment: raises the smelt chance to 50%.
node.toolmastery.smelt_3.desc: Enchantment: raises the smelt chance to 100% — every raw ore drops as an ingot.
node.toolmastery.dig_range_1.desc: Enchantment: breaking a block also breaks the one directly below it. Only pickaxe-mineable blocks of about the same hardness. Sneak to disable.
node.toolmastery.dig_range_2.desc: Enchantment: widens the break to a cross on the plane you are facing — 4 blocks around the one you hit, no corners.
node.toolmastery.dig_range_3.desc: Enchantment: widens the break to a full 3x3 on the plane you are facing.
node.toolmastery.rich_vein_1.desc: Enchantment: breaking an ore breaks the connected ores of the same kind with it, up to 8. Sneak to disable.
node.toolmastery.rich_vein_2.desc: Enchantment: raises the vein limit to 16 ores.
node.toolmastery.deep_haste.desc: Passive: permanent Haste I while you are below Y = 0. Never overrides a stronger Haste from a beacon or a potion.
node.toolmastery.obsidian_breaker.desc: Passive: obsidian and crying obsidian break 50% faster with a pickaxe.
node.toolmastery.enduring_edge.desc: Capstone passive: a Dig Range swing costs your pickaxe half the durability, rounded up — 1 point per 2 blocks at rank I, 3 per 5 at rank II, 5 per 9 at rank III. Unbreaking still applies; whichever saves more wins.
node.toolmastery.ancient_fortune.desc: Capstone passive: lifts the ceiling on vanilla Fortune from III to IV. Your enchanting table can offer Fortune IV from now on — nobody else's can.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms_1.desc: Passive: chop wood 25% faster with an axe.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms_2.desc: Passive: raises the chopping bonus to 50%.
node.toolmastery.lumberjacks_arms_3.desc: Passive: raises the chopping bonus to 75%.
node.toolmastery.loggers_magnet.desc: Passive: blocks chopped with an axe drop straight into your inventory, Logic fells included. Anything that does not fit stays on the ground.
node.toolmastery.fair_harvest.desc: Passive: +25% sapling drop chance from every leaf block you break, on top of the vanilla roll.
node.toolmastery.logic_1.desc: Enchantment: breaking one log fells the whole tree, log by log. The tree needs leaves, so log houses are safe. Chopping is slower while you carry only this level. Sneak to disable.
node.toolmastery.logic_2.desc: Enchantment: the whole tree falls at once, and the chopping penalty is gone.
node.toolmastery.logic_3.desc: Enchantment: the fell clears the canopy too — leaves come down with the trunk.
node.toolmastery.pruner.desc: Passive: leaves broken with an axe drop double loot — apples, saplings and sticks alike.
node.toolmastery.double_axe_1.desc: Passive: each log you chop has a 10% chance to drop twice. Every log of a Logic fell rolls on its own.
node.toolmastery.double_axe_2.desc: Passive: raises the double-drop chance to 20%.
node.toolmastery.shield_breaker.desc: Passive: your axes disable a blocking shield for 2 extra seconds and push 2 more damage through it. Deliberately works in PvP — Riposte is its counter.
node.toolmastery.environment.desc: Enchantment: a tree felled with Logic III replants its sapling on the stump, taking one from your inventory.
node.toolmastery.arcane_insight_1.desc: Passive: a panel beside the enchanting table reveals the true enchantments behind the first offer, before you pay for it.
node.toolmastery.arcane_insight_2.desc: Passive: the panel also reveals the second offer.
node.toolmastery.arcane_insight_3.desc: Passive: the panel reveals all three offers.
node.toolmastery.scholar_1.desc: Passive: +20% XP from every source — orbs, smelting, breeding, bottles.
node.toolmastery.scholar_2.desc: Passive: raises the XP bonus to 40%.
node.toolmastery.scholar_3.desc: Passive: raises the XP bonus to 60%.
node.toolmastery.inner_focus.desc: Passive: enchanting no longer requires or consumes lapis lazuli — your focus channels the table directly.
node.toolmastery.indestructible.desc: Enchantment: the item never breaks. Damage stops one point short, like an Elytra — but a spent item is inert until repaired: a tool digs at bare-hand speed and harvests nothing, right-click actions do nothing, and a worn armour piece protects for nothing — your armour bar shows the loss. The same goes for armour on a wolf, a horse or a nautilus.
node.toolmastery.anvil_adept_1.desc: Passive: anvil repairs, merges and renames cost 30% fewer levels, rounded up. The discount lands before the anvil decides a job is too expensive, so a 55-level merge comes down to 39 and becomes possible again.
node.toolmastery.anvil_adept_2.desc: Passive: your anvil never says 'Too Expensive'. Every job is capped at 40 levels — after the rank I discount — so a tool you keep repairing never prices itself out of existence.
node.toolmastery.ancient_knowledge.desc: Capstone passive: at a fully powered table (15 bookshelves) the three offers ask for 35, 40 and 45 instead of topping out at 30 — which is what finally puts Sharpness V and Efficiency V, impossible at a vanilla table, back in the draw. Nothing ever rolls above an enchantment's own maximum. At the 45 offer there is a chance, not a promise, of a perfect item: every enchantment the item can legally carry, each at its maximum, in a compatible set.

node.toolmastery.greater_mending.desc: Capstone passive: lifts the ceiling on vanilla Mending from I to II. Two Mending books merge into Mending II on your anvil — nobody else's — and Mending II mends twice the durability per point of experience.
node.toolmastery.reapers_wisdom.desc: Capstone passive: a mob killed with a Looting weapon gives more experience — +25% per level, so Looting III is +75%. It stacks on top of Scholar.
node.toolmastery.cartographer_1.desc: Passive: walking into a biome you have never visited prints its name and your coordinates in the action bar, and the skill screen keeps the list of what you have found. It is also what makes the biome gate legible.
node.toolmastery.tireless_1.desc: Passive: moving under your own power — walking, sprinting, swimming, jumping — costs 20% less hunger. Mining and taking damage are untouched; this is a movement perk, not a diet.
node.toolmastery.tireless_2.desc: Passive: raises the movement discount to 40%.
node.toolmastery.tireless_3.desc: Passive: raises the movement discount to 60%.
node.toolmastery.sea_legs.desc: Passive: a boat you are steering cruises about 15% faster. Passengers ride at whatever the person holding the tiller has earned.
node.toolmastery.night_eyes.desc: Passive: permanent Night Vision at 70% of the potion's strength — the night is clearly navigable without turning into day. A real Night Vision potion still beats it, and a warden still blinds you.
node.toolmastery.biome_chart_1.desc: Item: every purchase puts a real map in your inventory pointing at a random biome — a cheap gamble in XP, repeatable. The mod's first skill that buys you a thing rather than an ability.
node.toolmastery.biome_chart_2.desc: Item: the map now points only at biomes you have never set foot in, so every purchase is a guaranteed discovery for the biome checklist. Costs more XP than rank I, and the price climbs with your tier.
node.toolmastery.clear_sight_1.desc: Passive: underwater fog pushes out about as far as Respiration III gives, and stacks on top of it.
node.toolmastery.clear_sight_2.desc: Passive: the water goes fully clear, and your breath refills about twice as fast once you surface.
node.toolmastery.slipstream_1.desc: Enchantment for the Elytra: 10% of a firework's push carries over past the point where it would normally have died. Same rocket, more distance.
node.toolmastery.remember.desc: Passive: you respawn holding a named slip of paper with the coordinates, dimension and in-game day of your last death. It replaces the previous one each time, so it never becomes clutter.
node.toolmastery.trailblazer.desc: Passive: sprinting for more than 8 seconds without stopping ramps up to +12% movement speed, and dropping to a walk keeps it for 2 seconds. It rewards long overland runs, not fights.
node.toolmastery.soft_landing.desc: Passive: elytra wall-crash damage is halved and the first 3 blocks of any fall are free. Wingsuit insurance, not fall immunity.
node.toolmastery.waypoint.desc: Active: sneak and right-click with a compass to bind the spot you are standing on. The needle points there from then on, in that dimension, until you bind somewhere else.
node.toolmastery.pufferfish_lungs.desc: Capstone passive: every dive fills your lungs — 15 seconds of Water Breathing each time your head goes under. Stay down longer and the meter runs like anyone's; surface for a moment and the next dive refills it.
node.toolmastery.endless_horizon.desc: Capstone passive: a quarter of the fireworks you burn while flying are not consumed, and your Slipstream carryover doubles. The finisher of the class that never stops moving.
node.toolmastery.sorters_hand_1.desc: Passive: a Sort button in the corner of the inventory screen. One click groups your backpack by category and merges partial stacks. The hotbar, armour and pinned slots are left exactly where they are. It does not show up on a chest — sorting containers is the next rank.
node.toolmastery.sorters_hand_2.desc: Passive: the Sort button now appears on chests, barrels and shulker boxes too, and there it sorts the container. One button, aimed at whatever is in front of you.
node.toolmastery.chest_search_1.desc: Passive: a magnifier button in the corner of every screen. Type a word and every slot of your inventory holding a matching item turns yellow — Ctrl+F for your backpack. What you typed is forgotten when the screen closes.
node.toolmastery.chest_search_2.desc: Passive: the search lights up the open container as well as your inventory, and remembers what you typed from one chest to the next — walk a wall of chests looking for one thing, typing it once.
node.toolmastery.steady_grid.desc: Passive: the 3x3 grid keeps its contents when you close a crafting table instead of emptying into your inventory, and hands them back the next time you open one. Logging out gives everything back.
node.toolmastery.deft_hands.desc: Passive: when a hotbar stack runs out, the same item refills from your backpack automatically. Pinned slots are never refilled.
node.toolmastery.slot_lock.desc: Passive: alt-click any inventory slot to pin it. Sorting, auto-refill, Quick Stack and Restock all step around a pinned slot. This is the safety rail the capstone needs.
node.toolmastery.tidy_chests.desc: Passive: a container stays sorted — it is tidied again every time you close it, however many armfuls got thrown in while it was open.
node.toolmastery.sort_profiles.desc: Passive: pick the sort rule — category, name or count — with a button beside Sort, and everything you sort from then on follows it.
node.toolmastery.restock_nearby.desc: Passive: tops up the stacks you already carry from containers within 8 blocks. It only ever refills a type you already hold, so it never hands you something new and never fills your last free slot.
node.toolmastery.shulker_sight.desc: Open a shulker box straight from your inventory. Take from it and put into it without placing it down and picking it back up.
node.toolmastery.auto_block.desc: Nine of any ore material in your inventory pack themselves into the block on the spot — ingots, raw ore, coal, diamonds, emeralds, redstone, lapis, netherite, everything but quartz. Nine gold or iron nuggets pack into an ingot the same way. Pinned slots are never touched, and renamed or enchanted stacks are left alone.
node.toolmastery.hand_of_order.desc: Capstone passive: a Quick Stack button in the corner of the screen. Press it and every item in your backpack flies to the nearby container that already keeps that kind of thing — oak planks join the chest of birch and spruce, ruby ingots join the chest of iron and gold. It never starts a pile of its own, so anything with no home stays on you, and your hotbar and pinned slots are never touched.

node.toolmastery.keen_edge_1.desc: Enchantment: swords hit harder the fuller the attack cooldown was — up to +1 damage on a timed swing, nothing on a spammed one.
node.toolmastery.keen_edge_2.desc: Enchantment: up to +2 damage on a full swing.
node.toolmastery.keen_edge_3.desc: Enchantment: up to +3 damage on a full swing. Measured against the vanilla cooldown, so Nostalgy speeds your swing up without making this a flat bonus.
node.toolmastery.combat_magnet.desc: Passive: drops and XP from mobs you kill fly straight to you. The third magnet, after the Miner's and the Logger's.
node.toolmastery.butchers_cut.desc: Passive: a food-yielding mob killed with a sword drops twice the food.
node.toolmastery.sweeping_arc_1.desc: Enchantment: the sweep lands at half a full hit and reaches a block further.
node.toolmastery.sweeping_arc_2.desc: Enchantment: the sweep lands at full damage. Stacks with vanilla Sweeping Edge rather than replacing it.
node.toolmastery.broad_swing.desc: Passive: axes sweep like swords do, and accept vanilla Sweeping Edge at the table and the anvil.
node.toolmastery.second_wind.desc: Passive: every kill puts a point of saturation back. Small, but it changes what a long fight costs.
node.toolmastery.hunters_mark.desc: Passive: the mob you last hit is outlined for five seconds, and its remaining health goes on your action bar.
node.toolmastery.executioner_1.desc: Enchantment: +15% damage against anything below 30% health. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.executioner_2.desc: Enchantment: +30% damage against anything below 30% health. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.executioner_3.desc: Enchantment: +45% damage against anything below 30% health. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.tidecaller_1.desc: Enchantment: a thrown trident comes back to you without Loyalty.
node.toolmastery.tidecaller_2.desc: Enchantment: the trident returns faster still, and Riptide launches on dry land.
node.toolmastery.riposte.desc: Passive: a shield raised in the half-second before a hit throws a quarter of it back. The counter to Shield Breaker.
node.toolmastery.gravity_well_1.desc: Enchantment: a mace smash converts 25% more of your fall. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.gravity_well_2.desc: Enchantment: a mace smash converts 50% more of your fall. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.phalanx_1.desc: Enchantment: a spear reaches a block further. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.phalanx_2.desc: Enchantment: two blocks further, and a braced spear pricks anything standing against you. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.cleave.desc: Passive: an axe hit passes a third of itself to one mob beside the target. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.nostalgy_1.desc: Enchantment: the sword's attack cooldown recovers 25% faster. Works against players — this is the ladder back to 1.8 combat.
node.toolmastery.nostalgy_4.desc: Enchantment: the cooldown is gone. Every swing lands at full damage, in PvE and in PvP.
node.toolmastery.adrenaline.desc: Passive: eight seconds of unbroken fighting ramps to +15% damage and lingers three seconds after. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.storm_bearer.desc: Passive: Channeling works without a thunderstorm, once per in-game day.
node.toolmastery.sundering_blow_1.desc: Enchantment: ignores 20% of the target's armour. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.sundering_blow_2.desc: Enchantment: ignores 40% of the target's armour. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.bloodthirst.desc: Passive: each kill within five seconds of the last stacks +10% damage, to five stacks. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.headhunter.desc: Passive: mobs that can drop their heads do so far more often. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.spoils_of_war.desc: Passive: lifts your ceiling on vanilla Looting from III to IV, at the table and the anvil.
node.toolmastery.warlords_wake.desc: Passive: a killing blow releases a shockwave dealing half of it to everything within four blocks. Mobs only.
node.toolmastery.death_eyes.desc: Passive: you see every mob as one of the dead, and so does your sword — Smite applies in full to everything that is not a player. Opens only once the rest of the tree is bought.
mastery.toolmastery.unlock.fail.requires: This is the end of the tree: %s more node(s) to buy first.
screen.toolmastery.pve_only: Mobs only — never applies to players
screen.toolmastery.unlock_needs_all: Needs every other node in this tree (%s left)
advancements.toolmastery.armor.tier_1.de: Unlock tier 1 of the Armor tree — Path of the Bulwark.
advancements.toolmastery.armor.tier_2.de: Unlock tier 2 of the Armor tree — Path of the Bulwark.
advancements.toolmastery.armor.tier_3.de: Unlock tier 3 of the Armor tree — Path of the Bulwark.
advancements.toolmastery.armor.tier_4.de: Unlock tier 4 of the Armor tree — Path of the Bulwark.
advancements.toolmastery.armor.tier_5.de: Unlock tier 5 of the Armor tree — Path of the Bulwark.
node.toolmastery.flashpoint.desc: Passive: touching lava gives you 10 seconds of immunity to it. The window opens on contact and runs whatever you do with it — going back in does not extend it — and it only arms again once you have stopped burning. You still burn the whole time: this is one breath to swim out, not a bath.
node.toolmastery.padded_lining_1.desc: Passive: your armour takes 15% less durability damage. Dull on paper, and the node you will thank yourself for.
node.toolmastery.padded_lining_2.desc: Passive: raises the durability saving to 30%.
node.toolmastery.padded_lining_3.desc: Passive: raises the durability saving to 45%.
node.toolmastery.set_sense.desc: Passive: your real armour, toughness and the share of a hit they take off, drawn above the armour bar. Vanilla shows you ten identical icons and hides both numbers that decide the answer.
node.toolmastery.shield_wall_1.desc: Passive: a raised shield blocks instantly, with none of the five-tick delay vanilla makes you eat first. Those five ticks are the whole reason blocking feels late.
node.toolmastery.shield_wall_2.desc: Passive: the shield covers a noticeably wider arc, so a hit that came in from the side still counts as blocked.
node.toolmastery.steady_stance.desc: Passive: 25% less knockback from mobs. The cheap, always-on half of Warden's Weight.
node.toolmastery.thermal_weave_1.desc: Enchantment for chest and legs: about 25% less fire and lava damage. It is a real protection enchantment, so it adds to Fire Protection rather than competing with it for the slot.
node.toolmastery.thermal_weave_2.desc: Enchantment: raises the reduction to about 50%, and fire burns out twice as fast on you.
node.toolmastery.sure_footing.desc: Passive: nothing underfoot slows you down — soul sand, honey, anything a later version adds — and you swim and walk soul sand at half Depth Strider and half Soul Speed without the enchantments.
node.toolmastery.second_skin.desc: Passive: a piece never spends its last durability point, and tells you when it is close. It is the cheap, armour-only version of the Enchanter's Indestructible, which stays the universal one.
node.toolmastery.ablative_plating_1.desc: Enchantment: 20% less explosion damage, and a creeper no longer throws you at all.
node.toolmastery.ablative_plating_2.desc: Enchantment: raises the explosion reduction to 40%.
node.toolmastery.bulwark_1.desc: Enchantment for the shield: it takes 25% less durability damage.
node.toolmastery.bulwark_2.desc: Enchantment: raises the shield's durability saving to 50%.
node.toolmastery.bulwark_3.desc: Enchantment: 75% less shield durability, and an axe can no longer disable your shield at all — the direct answer to the Sword tree's Shield Breaker.
node.toolmastery.thorned_plate_1.desc: Enchantment: Thorns without the durability cost. A quarter of the hits you take come back at whoever landed them, and your armour pays nothing for it.
node.toolmastery.thorned_plate_2.desc: Enchantment: it fires half the time now, and hits for up to twice as much.
node.toolmastery.last_stand.desc: Passive: dropping below four hearts grants Resistance I for five seconds, once every thirty.
node.toolmastery.repair_rites.desc: Passive: your armour repairs a point of durability a second after ten seconds out of combat and standing still.
node.toolmastery.guardians_aura.desc: Passive: players and tamed animals within six blocks take 10% less damage. It does not stack with another Guardian, so a party is not four times as hard to kill.
node.toolmastery.kinetic_plating.desc: Enchantment for boots: the first six blocks of a fall are free and the rest hurts half as much. It adds to the Explorer's Soft Landing rather than replacing it.
node.toolmastery.wardens_weight.desc: Passive: nothing knocks you back while you are blocking, and swept attacks do not move you.
node.toolmastery.nightplate.desc: Passive: a full set of one material carries a bonus of its own. Leather keeps powder snow off you entirely, gold keeps piglins calm even when you open a chest in front of them, and netherite plants your feet the way it always did.
node.toolmastery.aegis.desc: Capstone passive: lifts your ceiling on vanilla Protection from IV to V, at the table and at the anvil. Everyone else's Protection still stops at IV — that is what makes it the capstone.
node.toolmastery.immortal_line.desc: Capstone passive: a hit that would kill you leaves you on one heart instead, with a few seconds of Regeneration and Resistance to get out. Once every ten minutes, and it costs no totem.
node.toolmastery.living_armor.desc: Capstone passive: experience you pick up mends the whole set at once, from any source and with no Mending on the pieces. The points go into the armour instead of your bar, which is the same bargain Mending strikes — made across four pieces rather than one random item.
advancements.toolmastery.armor.tier_6.de: Unlock tier 6 of the Armor tree — Path of the Bulwark.
advancements.toolmastery.armor.tier_7.de: Unlock the final tier of the Armor tree and claim its capstone.
perk.toolmastery.second_skin.warn: %1$s is down to its last: Second Skin is holding it together.
perk.toolmastery.immortal_line.held: The line holds. You are still here.
advancements.toolmastery.bow.tier_1.desc: Unlock tier 1 of the Bow tree — Path of the Arrow.
advancements.toolmastery.bow.tier_2.desc: Unlock tier 2 of the Bow tree — Path of the Arrow.
advancements.toolmastery.bow.tier_3.desc: Unlock tier 3 of the Bow tree — Path of the Arrow.
advancements.toolmastery.bow.tier_4.desc: Unlock tier 4 of the Bow tree — Path of the Arrow.
advancements.toolmastery.bow.tier_5.desc: Unlock tier 5 of the Bow tree — Path of the Arrow.
advancements.toolmastery.bow.tier_6.desc: Unlock tier 6 of the Bow tree — Path of the Arrow.
advancements.toolmastery.bow.tier_7.desc: Unlock the final tier of the Bow tree and claim its capstone.
node.toolmastery.fletchers_hands_1.desc: Bow draw and crossbow load are 20% faster. The node everyone buys first — the one that makes the tree feel worth opening.
node.toolmastery.fletchers_hands_2.desc: Bow draw and crossbow load are 40% faster.
node.toolmastery.fletchers_hands_3.desc: Bow draw and crossbow load are 60% faster. A full-power arrow leaves the string in half a second.
node.toolmastery.swift_draw_1.desc: You move at 40% speed while drawing a bow or loading a crossbow — vanilla slows you to 20%. Works in PvP: moving while you aim is visible and symmetric, the class's Nostalgy.
node.toolmastery.swift_draw_2.desc: You move at 60% speed while aiming.
node.toolmastery.swift_draw_3.desc: You move at 80% speed while aiming — nearly a full walk, arrow on the string.
node.toolmastery.quiver_sense.desc: The HUD names the arrow your bow will actually fire and how many of it you carry. Pure QoL — vanilla has genuinely never told you.
node.toolmastery.arrow_recovery_1.desc: 25% of the arrows you fired come back to your inventory, including ones that killed a mob or vanished into terrain. Only yours — never a skeleton's.
node.toolmastery.arrow_recovery_2.desc: 50% of the arrows you fired come back.
node.toolmastery.long_shot_1.desc: Enchantment, bow and crossbow: +10% damage past 25 blocks. Worth nothing in a corridor — the archer's Sharpness, priced on the class rule.
node.toolmastery.steady_aim.desc: Drawing while sneaking removes the bow's natural inaccuracy entirely — the arrow goes exactly where the crosshair points.
node.toolmastery.fletchers_bench.desc: Arrow crafting yields double, and chickens and parrots drop one more feather.
node.toolmastery.gale_1.desc: Enchantment, bow: arrow gravity cut 30%. A flatter arc is more range and less lead to guess — the part you actually feel.
node.toolmastery.gale_2.desc: Enchantment: arrow gravity cut 60%. The arc all but flattens on the way out.
node.toolmastery.ricochet_1.desc: Enchantment, bow: an arrow that kills bounces to a second target within 8 blocks at 50% damage.
node.toolmastery.ricochet_2.desc: Enchantment: the bounce reaches 12 blocks and carries 75% of the blow.
node.toolmastery.piercing_sight.desc: The mob you hit is outlined for three seconds, with its health in the action bar — the archer's Hunter's Mark, at the range where the dark actually eats targets.
node.toolmastery.rapid_reload_1.desc: The crossbow loads at full movement speed, sprint included. The reload no longer breaks your stride.
node.toolmastery.rapid_reload_2.desc: A crossbow stowed in your inventory loads itself — one every five seconds, drawing real ammunition, Multishot and Infinity rules included.
node.toolmastery.multishot_focus.desc: Multishot's three arrows converge instead of spraying, so all three can land on one target. Turns a crowd enchantment into a sniper one.
node.toolmastery.alchemists_quiver.desc: Tipped-arrow effects last 50% longer on mobs.
node.toolmastery.pinning_shot.desc: Enchantment, crossbow only: a hit roots the target for 1.5 seconds — it costs you the bow's rate of fire.
node.toolmastery.aerial_hunter.desc: +50% damage to airborne targets, and to anything you hit while you are flying an Elytra. Direct synergy with the Explorer's Slipstream.
node.toolmastery.endless_quiver.desc: Infinity also covers spectral arrows, and stops refusing to share a bow with Mending at the anvil.
node.toolmastery.deadeye.desc: Capstone: a fully drawn shot landing past 50 blocks is a guaranteed critical at double damage. The purest statement of the class rule.
node.toolmastery.storm_of_arrows.desc: Capstone: holding the draw past full charge banks up to two more arrows — real ones, ammunition and all — released as one volley.
node.toolmastery.hunters_bounty.desc: Capstone: lifts your ceiling on vanilla Power from V to VI, at the table and the anvil — raised in the data pack, clamped back for anyone without the node.
